item.title: Luke Skywalker's Single Greatest Star Wars Line Hits Harder Than Any Sci-Fi Quote Since
item.description: Since its 2018 debut, Rian Johnson’s The Last Jedi has sparked heated debate over whether it was a fantastic or terrible Star Wars film for Luke Skywalker. Still, whatever your opinion, it’s hard to deny that Johnson’s take on the greatest Jedi ever came with some truly epic quotes. And no, we’re not talking about the zinger, “Amazing. Every word of what you just said was wrong.”

item.title: Quentin Tarantino’s First New Movie in 7 Years Officially Arrives in Theaters Next Month
item.description: Quentin Tarantino fans have spent the better part of seven years waiting to see what one of the best filmmakers in the industry might do next. Since the Oscar-winning Once Upon a Time in Hollywood hit theaters in 2019, Tarantino has kept himself busy with books, interviews, and plans for what he once described as his final film. That milestone was initially meant to arrive in 2024 with The Movie Critic , but Quentin Tarantino famously shelved the script before production could begin, leaving fans in the dark about what could come next. But that's about to change next month.

item.title: 10 Best BG3 NPCs Fans Still Want To Join The Party All These Years Later
item.description: Baldur’s Gate 3 is full of moments like this: A great character, an intriguing story, and then no reliable way to learn what happens next. For Mizora — Wyll's patron devil, the one who granted him his warlock powers — a new mod has delivered a way around that issue. While Mizora technically does hang out in camp, she does so only on her terms — and when you see her, generally, you want to shove her back into whatever pocket of the Nine Hells she's crawled out of. Unless, of course, you can recruit her hellish talents to support your aims. Now, thanks to the mod Mizora Joins the Party from modder WorldWalker42 , you can do exactly that. She's not the only NPC who deserves an upgrade to companion status. Here are 10 more.

item.title: 10 Best Classic Shooters That Are So Good They Never Need A Remake
item.description: The 2000s represented a golden age for shooter games. Both first-person and third-person shooters saw a plethora of all-time classics released across a number of platforms during the aughts, while the immense success of consoles such as the PlayStation 2 and 3 and Xbox 360 helped spearhead the genre's push into the mainstream. More than two decades later, many of those games remain standard-bearers for shooters as a whole.

item.title: Penguin Colony was made to 'put the games industry on notice'
item.description: The latest game from Origanme Digital ( Umurangi Generation) reimagines H.P. Lovecraft's At the Mountains of Madness through the eyes of Antarctica's indigenous inhabitants, transforming a seemingly absurd premise into a deeply personal work of psychological horror. For Tali Faulkner, a Māori developer from New Zealand, the monsters of Penguin Colony aren't nearly as frightening as the real-world atrocities that inspired them.

item.title: 8 Years Later, a Buffy Star's Obscure Thriller Is Waiting to Be Discovered on Free Streaming
item.description: There was a time in the distant past when good things could occasionally come out of Twitter. Back in 2017, novelists Sam Sykes (the Aeons’ Gate series) and Chuck Wendig ( Blackbirds, Star Wars: Aftermath ) got on the website currently known as X to co-write an improvised horror satire . The result was a firmly tongue-in-cheek deconstruction of slasher movies, concerning Sykes' unnamed character’s new job as a camp counselor and an unfolding massacre in the woods. The story quickly went viral. (While the tweets are still up, Wendig has since abandoned X and locked his account, so the original story can no longer be read outside of a handful of unofficial screenshot archives.)

item.title: 5 Classic Nintendo Games That Are So Good They Never Need a Remake
item.description: Video games have been around for so many decades that the next time you sit down to play one, you’ll have tens of thousands of terrific options to choose from. A lot of us find ourselves playing newer releases when the time rolls around, because older titles have slipped from our minds. But they can also provide ample entertainment, if we give them a chance.

item.title: How to get the Pirate Shop Access Token in Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: The Pirate Shop Access Token is a new item introduced in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season , and it allows you to get anything from the Shop for free for a 14-day period.

item.title: All map fragment locations in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Fortnite 's Chapter 7 mini season , "Treasure Hunters," has added a new collectible to find throughout the season: map fragments . These map fragments will be added periodically during the season, and you'll get a special reward for finding them all.

item.title: Pokémon Go 'Halloween 2026 Part 2' event guide
item.description: Pokémon Go ’s second half of their 2026 Halloween event is rolling out (despite it being November now), and it runs from Nov. 1-5 . This portion of the event brings back some more old costumed Pokémon and includes the debut of shiny Greavard .
